recipe.visualDefinition: A cinematic night scene featuring a vintage white luxury car parked under a dark blue scalloped awning. Three figures in formal evening wear are posed around the vehicle, illuminated by a soft, warm spotlight against a dark, moody background. A glowing neon-style title arcs across the top of the awning.
coreVisualRelationships: The white car acts as the central horizontal anchor against the dark background.
The neon text follows the upward curve of the awning, creating a frame for the subjects.
The subjects' formal attire contrasts with the industrial texture of the brick wall behind them.
Warm skin tones and red accents pop against the dominant cool blue and black environment.
coreInvariants: Scalloped edge on the dark blue awning
Vintage 1930s-style white sedan with prominent fenders
Neon-tube lighting effect for the primary text
High-contrast noir lighting with deep shadows

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The car and figures occupy the lower two-thirds of the frame, centered horizontally.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large white front wheel and headlight of the vintage car.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the glowing neon text at the top, follows the curve of the awning down to the figures, and rests on the bright white car.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy black negative space on the left and right edges enhances the spotlight effect.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep midnight blue and black for the background and awning.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Creamy white for the car and neon text glow.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red for the dress and warm amber for the skin tones.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation in the environment with high value contrast between the car and the shadows.

letterConstructionRules: Double-line construction to mimic neon glass tubes
Open counters in letters like 'D' and 'O'
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'U' and 'N' have a continuous fluid motion
The 'J' has a deep, rounded hook
The 'X' is formed by two intersecting curved tubes
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single dominant neon display face with no secondary text.

candidateDirections.reason: To replicate the glass tube aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A cinematic night scene of a vintage 1930s white luxury car parked in front of a brick building under a dark blue scalloped awning. Three people in 1970s formal evening wear (tuxedo, red dress, black dress) are posed by the car. Noir lighting with deep shadows and a warm spotlight on the subjects.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a custom neon-style title in white with a soft glow, arched across the top of the blue awning. Use a double-line tubular font style with rounded ends.

verificationChecks: Is the text arched to match the awning curve?
Does the car have a distinct 1930s luxury silhouette?
Is the lighting high-contrast noir style?
Is the neon effect rendered with a soft outer glow?

adjustableVariables: Specific model of the vintage car
Number of figures in the scene
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the models
Exact brand logos on the car
Specific wording of the original title
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the awning has a scalloped white trim edge.
Check that the car is a creamy white, not pure digital white.
Verify the neon text looks like physical glass tubes.
Confirm the background remains dark and atmospheric.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Noir Nightclub Scene] + [Vintage Luxury Car] + [Arched Neon Typography] to create a [Retro Disco-Era Album Cover].
